jobs.occupation: Senior Manager Functional Safety Complex Systems, ADAS, AD (f/m/d) / 21762 (ADAS/AD Engineer)
jobs.description: Im Geschäftsbereich Mobilität suchen wir engagierte Talente, die den Weg für eine sichere, nachhaltige und smarte Mobilität von morgen ebnen möchten und damit Wegbereiter einer besseren Mobilität werden. Unser Fokus liegt auf der Sicherstellung der Verkehrssicherheit und Entwicklung innovativer Lösungen für alle Verkehrssysteme und -träger – von der Straße über die Schiene bis zur Luft. Mit unserer Expertise sorgen wir für mehr Sicherheit und Effizienz im Verkehr durch ganzheitliche Ansätze und fortschrittliche Konzepte.Activities und responsibilities- Plan, coordinate and conduct Functional Safety audits, assessments and technical reviews, including the evaluation of ISO 26262 work products from item definition and HARA through safety concepts, verification, validation and safety case documentation.- Create audit plans, assessment concepts, reports, findings, recommendations and certification-relevant documentation.- Review SOTIF work products and assess evidence for complex data-driven systems, covering functional insufficiencies, triggering conditions, ODD, intended use, foreseeable misuse, data representativeness, scenario coverage, monitoring, fallback and residual-risk arguments.- Develop assessment and evidence concepts for AI-driven systems where deterministic assurance is insufficient; support Type Approval and homologation by translating Functional Safety, SOTIF, AI and regulatory requirements—e.g., UN R171/DCAS—into practical guidance.- Deliver consultancy and support business acquisition through customer workshops, pre-sales, technical interviews, bid support, gap analyses, document reviews, pre-assessments and project reviews; contribute to service development for automated driving and AI-enabled vehicle systems.- Coordinate international projects and harmonise technical delivery across regions and business units globally; connect Functional Safety, SOTIF, AI, cybersecurity, testing, certification and Type Approval at subject and team level while strengthening internal capabilities through guidance, training and knowledge sharing.Experience und further qualifications- Senior automotive safety expert with hands-on experience in safety-critical E/E systems, embedded software, ADAS/AD, simulation-based verification, validation and testing, complemented by a background in software development, systems engineering, architecture and technical project delivery- Extensive Functional Safety expertise under ISO 26262/8800, including safety lifecycle, HARA, ASIL, ASPICE, safety concepts, safety analyses and safety case documentation; experienced with FMEA, FMEDA, FTA, DFA, STPA and comparable methods- Sound knowledge of SOTIF according to ISO 21448 and its interaction with Functional Safety for perception-based and data-driven functions; familiarity with Type Approval, homologation, software update management and automotive cybersecurity is beneficial- Strong understanding of automotive AI and machine-learning applications, including perception, sensor fusion, prediction, planning, decision-making, monitoring and fallback; able to assess systems with limited explainability and incomplete scenario coverage- Broad knowledge of automotive development processes, including requirements engineering, configuration and change management, validation planning, tool qualification and evidence management; experienced in audits, assessments, confirmation reviews and independent technical evaluations- Consulting, pre-sales, business acquisition and bid-process experience, combined with strong analytical judgement, a structured auditor mindset, customer orientation and excellent communication skills; fluent in German and English, with willingness to travel internationally.

jobs.description: OUR COMPANYAt Boehringer Ingelheim we develop breakthrough therapies and innovative healthcare solutions in areas of unmet medical need for both humans and animals. As a family owned company, we focus on long-term performance. We believe that, if we have talented and ambitious people who are passionate about innovation, there is no limit to what we can achieve; after all, we started with just 28 people. Now, we are powered by 50,000 employees globally who nurture a diverse, collaborative and inclusive culture.The PositionAre you passionate about shaping the legal framework of sustainability and responsible business practices?As Senior Legal Counsel ESG Law, you will provide highly specialized legal advice on Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) matters and support the effective integration of Boehringer Ingelheim's SD4G framework.By translating evolving legal and regulatory requirements into practical guidance, you will enable strategic ESG initiatives across the organization and advise on Social Engagement projects, including those with proximity to venture capital mechanisms.Tasks & responsibilities- Provide strategic legal counsel on ESG-related legal and regulatory requirements, enabling Boehringer Ingelheim to advance its sustainability and social responsibility ambitions in a compliant and future-oriented manner.- Shape the legal interpretation of emerging ESG regulations, including current and upcoming frameworks such as the EU Taxonomy and Corporate Sustainability Reporting Directive (CSRD), the EU Corporate Sustainability Due Diligence Directive (CSDDD), the EU Empowering Consumers Directive (Green Claims), as well as product compliance related frameworks such as the EU Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation and translate requirements into actionable business guidance and contractual clauses.- Act as the trusted Legal Business Partner for the Corporate Sustainability team and serve as the central legal contact for the global coordination of SD4G-related matters across Global Legal and Compliance.- Drive the development of pragmatic legal solutions that support reporting obligations, corporate governance requirements, and organizational structures across national and international jurisdictions.- Support impactful sustainability and social engagement initiatives together with the Boehringer Ingelheim Venture Fund legal team by advising on legal risks and opportunities and by structuring, drafting, and negotiating agreements, including transaction, loan, cooperation, and sponsorship contracts.- Represent the Global Legal & Compliance function in relevant committees, steering groups, and external peer networks, fostering collaboration and bringing legal ESG perspectives into strategic Saarland University is a campus university that is internationally recognized for its strong research programmes. Fostering young academic talent and creating ideal conditions for teaching and research are a core part of the university’s mission. As part of the University of the Greater Region, Saarland University enables students and staff to share and exchange knowledge and ideas between disciplines, between universities and across borders. After one year at level 1 of the E13 pay grade, an employee will move up to level 2. After a further two years, the employee will move to level 3, etc.•A very good command of English. Knowledge of German is helpful but not requiredWhat we offer:• The opportunity to conduct cutting-edge research and publish with the research group.• The opportunity to develop your own research agenda and strengthen your academic profile.• Funding for conferences, research activities, and further training.• Access to state-of-the-art research infrastructure.• A motivated, engaged, and supportive team.• Links to the newly established Societal Observatory Using Novel Data Sources (SOUNDS).• A flexible work schedule allowing you to balance work and family, among other things the possibility ofteleworking• Secure and future-oriented employment with attractive conditions• A broad range of further education and professional development programmes (for example language courses)• An occupational health management model with numerous attractive options, such as our university sportsprogramme• Supplementary pension scheme (RZVK)• Discounted tickets on local public transport services (‘Job-Ticket‘ of the saarVV)• Job bike leasing (JobRad)We look forward to receiving your meaningful online application (in a single PDF file, including a cover letter outlining your substantive research interests and methodological expertise, your CV, the contact details of one ortwo academic references, and a recent working paper or your job market paper) by 15.11.2026 to valentin.lang@uni-saarland.de. Part-time employment is generally possible.If you have obtained a foreign university degree,a proof of the equivalence of this degree with a German degree by theZentralstelle für ausländisches Bildungswesen (ZAB) is needed before hiring. If necessary, please apply for this in time. You can find more information at https://www.kmk.org/zeugnisbewertung.Unfortunately, neither costs for attending an interview at Saarland University nor costs for any certificate evaluation by the ZAB can be reimbursed in principle.We welcome applications regardless of gender, nationality, ethnic and social origin, religion/belief, disability, age, and sexual orientation and identity.
